annotations.title: Look up frost dates for a place

description: Average last spring frost, average first fall frost and hardiness zone for any place, from 10 years of weather records. Works without a Siltwell account. Dates are MM-DD. For the signed-in user's own garden, get_plan returns the garden's zone and frost dates, with the frost dates adjusted for its microclimate.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Give it with longitude instead of place.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Give it with latitude instead of place.

place.description: Town plus region or country, for example "Portland, Oregon". Omit it to use the signed-in user's garden.

name: lookup_frost_dates
title: Look up frost dates for a place
